collection.title: Mazda 6 Estate 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mazda 6 Estate 2018 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Notched Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Mazda 6, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Mazda 6 Estate 2018 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
